Telemetry_Info_Message:
This feature sends anonymous data to help improve RagnaVezérlő:

• App version and operating system
• Crash reports with stack traces
• Basic usage statistics (no personal data)

Data is sent via Discord Webhook for easy monitoring.

Tut.1_Desc: Welcome to RagnaVezérlő! This tutorial will help you get started.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-Irányítógomb to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. Nyomd meg 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: Casting Storm Gust has never been easier. Tart down your skill button (e.g., L1+A). The targeting circle appears. Aim with the right stick. Simply RELEASE the button to cast the spell!
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the Jobbra Karbantartás slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? Felvétel your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline Szerkesztésor. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
